artifacts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a new sibling high-fidelity iOS UI design board by adapting the attached app mockup to a DICTATION FLOW. Preserve the reference design language and shared lesson header. Input image 1 is the source layout/style reference; replace the three screen bodies with the states below. Do not modify the original file.
Landscape board with THREE equal flat 390:844 portrait screens, light neutral gutters, no hardware, no perspective, no shadows. Native PingFang/SF sans-serif, pure white, nearly black text, muted slate secondary text, blue #087EA4 controls. Compact restrained typography. Fine gray separators, 8pt button corners. No gradients, decorative backgrounds, mascot, statistic cards or fake mastery.

ALL SCREENS: status bar 9:41. Back chevron left, centered "第 1 册 · 第 007 课", ellipsis right. Left-aligned title "Are you a teacher?" and subtitle "你是教师吗？". Local segment "听读" | "单词" | "练习", active 练习. Mode row "听写练习" with down chevron and "3 / 10" right. No global bottom tab bar anywhere. Keep the same header positions and margins on all three. All text exact and readable.

LEFT / BEFORE INPUT: small prompt "听音频，写出单词". Centered medium blue outlined speaker button with label "再听一次". No English word, definition or answer illustration yet. Below a full-width input field with placeholder "输入英文单词". Plenty of whitespace. Bottom action full-width "检查答案" rendered disabled pale gray with clearly legible gray text, secondary "跳过". Keep a 24pt noninteractive white separation after actions, then fixed light-gray banner block labeled "AdMob 横幅占位" and bottom safe area with home indicator. Banner about60pt high. No keyboard.

MIDDLE / KEYBOARD VISIBLE: same header, mode, prompt and compact replay button. Input is focused, blue border, contains EXACT misspelling "enginer" and cursor at end. No autocorrect or prediction row. Full-width blue "检查答案" then small "跳过" immediately above keyboard, with comfortable white gaps. Realistic full native iOS English QWERTY keyboard occupies lower roughly255pt: rows qwertyuiop / asdfghjkl / zxcvbnm, shift, delete, 123, space, return; light gray keyboard with white keys. Include home indicator in keyboard bottom safe area. While keyboard is open the ad banner is intentionally HIDDEN and its reserved space removed. No banner above, below or behind keyboard. Keep input and submit visible without overlap. Use whitespace efficiently without shrinking text. Do not reveal correct answer.

RIGHT / INCORRECT SPELLING FEEDBACK, keyboard closed: same header, "3 / 10". A modest red x-circle and title "再记一次". Under it label "你的答案" with "enginer" in muted red, then "正确拼写" with bold "engineer" and blue speaker icon, then "n. 工程师". Thin separator. Compact supportive ink-and-watercolor illustration of an adult engineer at drafting table, small (around70pt) and secondary, matching reference artwork aesthetic. Beside/below it exact example "I'm an engineer." and "我是工程师。". No score change shown, no countdown or automatic advance. Bottom fixed blue full-width "下一题", secondary "退出本次练习", 24pt white separation, then restored banner of same position/size as left "AdMob 横幅占位", home indicator safe area.

Outside screens, captions under each: "听写 · 待输入", "听写 · 键盘展开", "听写 · 答题反馈". Bottom small neutral board note: "设计补充 · 输入时暂隐横幅，收起键盘后恢复". This note must be outside app. All screens complete with equal bounds and consistent visual rhythm. Keep advertisement, buttons and home indicator distinct. Do not insert implementation notes inside the app. Render all Chinese precisely.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a new sibling high-fidelity iOS design board adapting the attached approved mockups to FIRST USE AND EMPTY STATES. Image1 is the home/catalog layout and style reference. Image2 is the wordbook layout, banner and settings style reference. Preserve this visual system; replace the three screens with the following states, without altering original files.
Landscape board, THREE equal flat 390:844 portrait screens side by side, narrow pale neutral gutters, straight-on, no device hardware, shadows or perspective. Native SF/PingFang sans-serif, white surfaces, near-black text, muted slate, restrained blue #087EA4. Refined thin ink/watercolor volume-one book-and-speech-bubble thumbnail. Compact typography, 20pt horizontal margins, flat separated rows, no oversized cards or cartoon mascot.

SHARED: 9:41 status bar, large but restrained left title, settings sliders icon top-right. Compact book row with small burgundy open-book/speech-bubble illustration, "第 1 册", "英语初阶", right "切换" chevron. Fixed light-gray block near bottom labeled "AdMob 横幅占位" about60pt high. White noninteractive separation around banner. Bottom native tabs "学习" | "课程" | "单词本", recognizable thin icons, blue active tab, safe area/home indicator. All three screens equal size. No keyboards shown.

LEFT / FIRST VISIT LEARNING HOME: title "学习", active 学习 tab. After book row thin separator. Small blue eyebrow "开始学习"; line "第 001 课"; title "Excuse me!" in about28pt semibold, subtitle "对不起！". Primary full-width blue button "开始听读" with white play triangle. Below two compact actions separated by fine vertical rule: "本课单词", "本课练习". Section label "最近学习", thin separator, subdued simple clock-outline icon and two short lines "还没有学习记录" / "学过的课文会显示在这里". Do not invent recent lessons, completed state, progress, scores or streak. Quiet whitespace before banner; do not repeat the same CTA. User can change book before starting. No onboarding carousel or permission dialog.

MIDDLE / COURSE SEARCH NO RESULTS: title "课程", active 课程 tab. Same book row. Search field light gray with magnifier and exact query "zzzz", clear-x icon at right. Section label "搜索结果". In content center above middle, small subtle magnifier icon then heading "没有找到课文", secondary two lines "试试课号、英文标题或译文". Low-emphasis blue text action "清除搜索". No invented lessons. No network error symbol, loading spinner or offline message: this is a local search empty result. Keep large natural whitespace and bottom banner/tabs identical layout to left.

RIGHT / WORDBOOK WRONG-WORD FILTER EMPTY: title "单词本", active 单词本 tab. Same book row. Search field placeholder "搜索单词或释义". Filter row: left "全部状态" down chevron, thin divider, right "仅错词" native blue ON toggle. Thin separator. Content empty state centered: small outline check-circle blue, heading "暂时没有错词", secondary "练习中的错词会显示在这里". Secondary blue text action "查看本册课程". No word rows, no numerical mastery claims, no enabled "开始复习" button when result set is empty. Do not say the whole lesson is mastered or all words learned. No celebration/confetti, trophy, mascot, reward, chart.
Screens show alternative example states rather than a chronological user journey.

Captions BELOW screens, outside app: "首次使用 · 无学习记录", "课程搜索 · 无结果", "单词本 · 暂无错词". Tiny footer "设计补充 · 首次使用与空状态". Chinese text exact. Every banner and tab remains visible and separated. Adult calm learning app, match attached reference closely.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the attached three-screen iOS first-use and empty-state mockup with ONE tiny correction only. On the LEFTMOST screen, remove the right-pointing chevron at the far right of the "最近学习" section heading. This section has no records, so it must not show a navigation affordance. Landscape board with THREE equal flat 390:844 portrait screens, pale neutral gutters, no phones, no perspective, no shadows. White surfaces, near-black SF/PingFang sans-serif, slate-gray secondary text, accent blue #087EA4. 20pt side margins, fine separators, compact native typography, 8pt button corners. Avoid giant decorative titles, confetti, medals, trophy, cards inside cards, graphs, gradients.

SHARED ALL: 9:41. Back chevron, centered "第 1 册 · 第 007 课", ellipsis. Left aligned title "Are you a teacher?" and "你是教师吗？". Local segments "听读" | "单词" | "练习", active 练习. No global tab bar. LEFT / WRONG ANSWER FEEDBACK: mode has down chevron, "3 / 10" right. Small instruction "选择正确释义". Prompt "engineer" at28pt semibold. Four full-width option rows around40pt height, 7pt gaps:
